response.sql: SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(*) AS num_transactions FROM trans WHERE amount > 2400 GROUP BY account_id ORDER BY num_transactions DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The request's `trans.account_id` is the real column `account_id`, which is the owning account. It is not `trans.account`, which holds the partner's account.
All transaction types are included, whether PRIJEM, VYDAJ or VYBER. The request only filters on amount, and amounts are stored unsigned.
Accounts with the same transaction count have no stated tie-break, so which of them fall in the top 10 is arbitrary.
